name: Blackout
text: The lamps die at dusk. Every tool costs double the time.

name: Storm
text: Rain on the glass. Fewer customers brave it; everyone wants more.

name: Auction night
text: The auctioneer is first through the door, with one fine lot.

name: Full moon
text: Curses double: twice as many arrive, and each weighs twice as much. Buyers pay extra for them.
